description: Create multiple time entries in one call. Supply an 'entries' array where each item has subtask_id, date (YYYY-MM-DD), and hours (> 0 and ≤ 24); optionally start_time (HH:mm, defaults to 09:00) and text. Entries are always attributed to you. Returns per-item results (partial failures are reported rather than aborting the batch). Max 50 entries.

entries.description: List of time entries to create (max 50).

start_time.description: Optional start time in 24-h HH:mm (defaults to 09:00).

subtask_id.description: Id of the subtask to log time against.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

name: bulk_create_time_reports
